name: Anadolu Hayat Emeklilik Anonim Sirketi
summary: Anadolu Hayat Emeklilik Anonim Sirketi provides private pension and life insurance products in Turkey. The company offers private pension products, including individual, non-sponsored group, employer-sponsored, and income drawdown plans; auto-enrolment plans; and life insurance products, such as savings and endowment, annuities, and term life. It also provides personal and group accident insurance products. In addition, the company provides conservative, balanced, dynamic, and aggressive pension funds.
